turns.prompt:
You are given one attached CSV file:
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

No property values are provided. Using your knowledge of crystal optics,
crystal symmetry and structure-property relationships, predict which
candidates have the HIGHEST birefringence at 1064 nm, then select the 5 best
candidates from the pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The magnitude of birefringence is governed by the anisotropy of the electronic polarizability density. Cubic crystals (and nearly cubic packings of isotropic tetrahedra) therefore have \(\Delta n\approx0\). The largest values arise when highly anisotropic anionic groups are co-aligned.

The six Na–Sr–B–S candidates contain isolated planar \(\mathrm{BS}_3\) triangles (the thio-analogue of the classic \(\mathrm{BO}_3\) unit). Inspection of the fractional coordinates shows that in the four primitive cells the three S atoms that complete each triangle share a common Cartesian coordinate with B, proving that every \(\mathrm{BS}_3\) plane is parallel. The resulting macroscopic polarizability tensor is therefore maximally anisotropic. Among these four, the two settings whose unique axis is shortest (c040, c043) pack the triangles most densely and are ranked first; the remaining two primitive cells follow.

The fifth-ranked crystal, RbGeI\(_3\), combines a stereo-active Ge(II) lone pair with the extremely polarizable iodide ligand in a pronounced one-dimensional packing (\(a=4.56\,\text{Å}\)). This combination produces a comparably large (though chemically distinct) optical anisotropy.

All other chemistries in the pool—tetrahedral diamond-like networks, wurtzite polytypes, undistorted perovskites and three-dimensional sulfides—lack either intrinsically anisotropic building units or co-alignment, and therefore exhibit substantially smaller \(\Delta n\).

Final: c040, c043, c042, c041, c039
